summary: Built a fresh three-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster (Ubuntu 16.04 i386, apt package) across node1/node2/node3 holding application keys, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir) while quorum on node1+node2 kept serving reads/writes. Removed the dead member via etcdctl, added a new member for node3, reconfigured it with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, and started it - it joined and caught up via the raft log, restoring three healthy members with all original application keys intact. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: rebooted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time, confirming boot_id changes and full etcd/cluster-membership recovery with data intact after each.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes: no etcd installed, Ubuntu 16.04 i686, static IPs 10.100.231.10-12
Installed etcd 2.2.5 via apt on node1, node2, node3

Configured a static 3-member cluster in /etc/default/etcd on each node; corrected an issue where apt auto-started etcd as standalone single-node instances before config was applied by stopping/disabling, wiping stale data dirs, then re-enabling and starting all three together to properly bootstrap the 3-member cluster
Verified cluster-health (3/3 healthy) and member list
Wrote application keys (/app/config/db_host, /app/config/feature_flag, /app/service/name, /app/counter) via etcdctl on node1 and confirmed replication/readability on node2 and node3

Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped etcd on node3 and wiped its data directory; confirmed node1/node2 quorum remained healthy and accepted a new write (counter 42->43) while node3 was down
Removed the dead member (ID 70295956b9250d21) via etcdctl member remove on node1
Added a new member for node3 via etcdctl member add; updated node3's /etc/default/etcd with the returned ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER and ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing; started etcd on node3
Verified the new node3 member (ID 4edf739d42c7d079) joined, cluster reports 3/3 healthy, member list shows node1/node2/node3, and all original application keys plus the new write are present on node3

Ran mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes, rebooted node1 -> node2 -> node3 sequentially (one at a time, quorum preserved throughout), polled each until reachable, confirmed each boot_id changed, and confirmed etcd active + cluster-health 3/3 + application keys intact after each restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline: 3-member etcd cluster running with application keys before any disruption
evidence.summary: cluster-health shows 3/3 healthy members (node1/node2/node3); application keys written on node1 and read back successfully on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost while quorum/service preserved
evidence.summary: etcd stopped and data dir wiped on node3; cluster-health from node1 shows node3's member unreachable while node1/node2 remain healthy and cluster still accepts a new write (/app/counter=43)

evidence.requirement: Replace lost node3 member with a working member on the same node
evidence.summary: Dead member 70295956b9250d21 removed via etcdctl; new member 4edf739d42c7d079 added for node3; etcd started on node3 with existing-cluster config and joined, log shows leader election and successful publish

evidence.requirement: Cluster restored to three healthy members with existing keys intact
evidence.summary: cluster-health reports 3/3 healthy (node1, node2, new node3 member); member list confirms 3 members; all original application keys (db_host, feature_flag, service/name) and counter=43 read successfully from both node1 and the rebuilt node3

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 225ffbf7...; reboot acknowledged then connection refused confirming disconnection; post-reboot boot_id changed to 3b4c0312...; etcd active, cluster-health 3/3 healthy, keys intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6ab98831...; reboot acknowledged then connection refused; post-reboot boot_id changed to e2d2eb7a...; etcd active, cluster-health 3/3 healthy, keys intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id (post-rebuild) 2b3a8d87...; reboot acknowledged then connection refused; post-reboot boot_id changed to eeccebd7...; etcd active, cluster-health 3/3 healthy, member list correct, all application keys and counter intact
